targetText:
What we must create is the human being of the 21stcentury, although
this is still a subjective aspiration, not yet systematized.
explanation: Che insists that socialist culture must look boldly forward to create the liberated human being of the future, rather than recycling outdated bourgeois forms or sterile dogmas.

targetText:
But why try to find the only valid prescription in the frozen forms of
socialist realism? We cannot counterpose "freedom" to socialist realism,
because the former does not yet exist and will not exist until the complete
development of the new society.
explanation: Che critiques rigid Soviet-style Socialist Realism as a return to 19th-century bourgeois academic art, arguing for authentic experimentation and creative cultural development under socialism.
